label: End of long sequences starting with i: last original token and <DEL>
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.0085% of steps). Fires only at the last original token (t = L-1) and the <DEL> step (t = L, about 69% of mass), never during the copy phase or before t = 7. Nearly all activity is in long sequences (L = 9 gives 82% of mass, L = 8 gives 18%) whose first original token is i (75% of mass; g is a weaker second at 10%). When it fires on the last original token, that token is often m (5x lift); the top examples often fire on both the last token and <DEL>. Precision is very low (about 2%): most long i-initial sequences do not activate it. The activating ones share mid-sequence tokens (n at position 2, k/w/m at position 4, for example), but adding those conditions cut recall without much gain in precision, so the full conjunctive context is not captured. Magnitude: the largest activations come from L >= 8 sequences starting with i. I did not find a simple variable that modulates magnitude beyond that.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=i (+5.26), orig4=k (+3.08), orig3=k (+2.91), orig0=g (+2.65), orig2=n (+2.63), orig1=q (+2.47). Lower it: next_out=- (-4.22), correct=1 (-3.66), orig7=- (-3.12), in_count=1 (-2.84).
